keywords.name: 暴击率
keywords.description: The chance for an item with a Cooldown to critically hit, doubling its Damage, Heal, Shield, Regen, Burn and Poison active effects
keywords.descriptionZh: 带有冷却时间的物品发生暴击的几率，暴击会使其伤害、治疗、护盾、生命再生、灼烧和剧毒主动效果翻倍

keywords.name: 暴击文本
keywords.description: Crit Chance
keywords.descriptionZh: 暴击率

keywords.name: 充能
keywords.description: Immediately advances an item's Cooldown
keywords.descriptionZh: 立即推进一件物品的冷却时间

keywords.name: 储存箱
keywords.description: Stashes provide an alternate look to the Stash (lower left) on your board during gameplay. Each stash has a unique interior design. Mix and match collectibles to come up with your favorite loadout.
keywords.descriptionZh: 储存箱可以为游戏过程中布阵区左下角的储存箱提供另一种外观。每个储存箱都有独特的内部设计。自由搭配收藏品，打造你最喜爱的配装。

keywords.name: 弹药
keywords.description: When an item runs out of Ammo, it can no longer fire. Ammo refills after each fight
keywords.descriptionZh: 当物品弹药耗尽时，将无法再发动。每场战斗后弹药会重新填满

keywords.name: 冻结
keywords.description: Frozen items cannot activate
keywords.descriptionZh: 被冻结的物品无法发动

keywords.name: 多重释放
keywords.description: When you use this item, its effect happens multiple times
keywords.descriptionZh: 使用此物品时，其效果会触发多次（视为多次使用）

keywords.name: 飞行
keywords.description: Flying items are affected by Freezes and Slow for half as long
keywords.descriptionZh: 飞行物品受到冻结和减速影响的时间减半

keywords.name: 附魔
keywords.description: Adds a unique new effect to the item
keywords.descriptionZh: 为物品添加一个独特的新效果

keywords.name: 刚刚购买
keywords.description: They don't want to buy this item
keywords.descriptionZh: 他们不想购买此物品

keywords.name: 护盾
keywords.description: Blocks Damage. Ignored by Poison and reduces Burn Damage by half
keywords.descriptionZh: 抵挡伤害。会将灼烧伤害减半，剧毒伤害则不受护盾影响

keywords.name: 黄金
keywords.description: The amount of Gold you currently have
keywords.descriptionZh: 你当前拥有的金币数量

keywords.name: 加速
keywords.description: Items with Haste charge twice as fast
keywords.descriptionZh: 受到加速效果的物品充能速度提高为两倍

keywords.name: 减速
keywords.description: Items with Slow charge half as fast
keywords.descriptionZh: 受到减速效果的物品充能速度减半

keywords.name: 节奏
keywords.description: You gain 1 Tempo per second. Tempo can be spent by items and skills for bonus effects.
keywords.descriptionZh: 你每秒获得1点节奏。节奏可被物品和技能消耗，以触发额外效果。

keywords.name: 金库
keywords.description: Banks provide an alternate look to the Bank (lower right) on your board during gameplay. Each bank has a unique progression of riches. Mix and match collectibles to come up with your favorite loadout.
keywords.descriptionZh: 银行可以为游戏过程中布阵区右下角的银行提供另一种外观。每个银行都有独特的财富积累呈现方式。自由搭配收藏品，打造你最喜爱的配装。

keywords.name: 经验值
keywords.description: Collect 8 XP to gain a level. New levels provide Max Health and special rewards
keywords.descriptionZh: 收集8点经验值即可提升一级。每个新等级都会提供最大生命值和特殊的奖励

keywords.name: 剧毒
keywords.description: Damages Players every second
keywords.descriptionZh: 每秒对玩家造成伤害

keywords.name: 空间不足
keywords.description: You have no space for that
keywords.descriptionZh: 你没有空间放置该物品

keywords.name: 怒火
keywords.description: Reach 100 Rage to become Enraged, removing Slow and Freeze from your items. When Enraged, your item cooldowns are reduced by 10%
keywords.descriptionZh: 累积100点怒火即可进入暴怒状态，这会解除己方物品的减速和冻结效果。暴怒期间，己方物品的冷却时间缩短10%

keywords.name: 升级
keywords.description: Increases an item's tier, which improves its effectiveness and value
keywords.descriptionZh: 提升一件物品的级别，从而提高其效果和价值

keywords.name: 生命再生
keywords.description: Adds Health equal to your Regen every second
keywords.descriptionZh: 每秒增加等量于你生命再生量的生命值

keywords.name: 声望
keywords.description: Losing fights against Players results in prestige loss equal to the day. If your prestige hits zero, your run ends
keywords.descriptionZh: 在对战玩家中战败将损失等同于当前天数的声望。若声望归零，本次冒险即告结束

keywords.name: 收入
keywords.description: The amount of Gold you gain at the start of each day
keywords.descriptionZh: 每天开始时你获得的金币数量

keywords.name: 退出
keywords.description: Exit this encounter
keywords.descriptionZh: 离开此遭遇事件

keywords.name: 无法购买
keywords.description: You can't afford that
keywords.descriptionZh: 你买不起这件物品

keywords.name: 吸血
keywords.description: When dealing Damage, recover Health equal to the amount of Damage dealt
keywords.descriptionZh: 造成伤害时，恢复等量于所造成伤害的生命值

keywords.name: 修复
keywords.description: Returns a destroyed item to normal
keywords.descriptionZh: 将被摧毁的物品恢复正常

keywords.name: 音乐集
keywords.description: Albums provide a custom playlist for your runs in The Bazaar. Each album features over XX tracks. Happy listening!
keywords.descriptionZh: 专辑可以为你在《大巴扎》中的冒险提供自定义播放列表。每张专辑收录超过XX首曲目。祝你听得愉快！

keywords.name: 战斗已锁定
keywords.description: Combat will begin shortly.
keywords.descriptionZh: 战斗即将开始。

keywords.name: 治疗
keywords.description: Recover your Health, up to your Max Health. Cleanses 5% Poison and Burn
keywords.descriptionZh: 恢复生命值，最高可恢复至最大生命值。净化治疗量5%的剧毒和灼烧

keywords.name: 重掷
keywords.description: Reroll this Merchant's supply
keywords.descriptionZh: 重掷该商人的商品

keywords.name: 转化
keywords.description: Changes an item into a new form. Retains tier and Enchantments if able. Legendaries cannot be transformed
keywords.descriptionZh: 将物品转化为新的形态。会尽可能保留物品的级别和附魔。传说级物品无法被转化

keywords.name: 灼烧
keywords.description: Damages Players twice per second. Every time Burn deals Damage it decreases by 3%
keywords.descriptionZh: 每秒对玩家造成两次伤害。每次灼烧造成伤害时，伤害逐次减少3%。

keywords.name: Boards
keywords.description: Game Boards provide an entirely new world to play on - from Pelago’s vibrant coast to the cacti of Jabalia. Try clicking everything; each board has a secret “sequence” to unlock!
keywords.descriptionZh: 游戏布阵区可以为你带来全新的游玩世界——从佩拉戈生机勃勃的海岸，到贾巴利亚的仙人掌。试着点击每一处；每个布阵区都藏有可解锁的秘密“序列”！

keywords.name: CardBacks
keywords.description: Card Backs protect the underside of your cards. Before combat, your opponent will see your Card Backs flip into life, so choose wisely!
keywords.descriptionZh: 卡牌背面用于保护卡牌的背侧。战斗开始前，对手会看到你的卡牌背面翻转亮相，所以要慎重选择！

keywords.name: CardSkins
keywords.description: Card Skins add premium animation to your in-game cards. Card Skins are automatically (and always) equipped.
keywords.descriptionZh: 卡牌皮肤会为你的游戏内卡牌添加高级动画效果。卡牌皮肤会自动（且始终）装备。

keywords.name: Carpets
keywords.description: Rugs provide a unique look to your available item slots. Pick the rug that fits your aesthetic!
keywords.descriptionZh: 地毯可以为你的可用物品栏位带来独特的外观。挑选符合你审美的地毯吧！

keywords.name: Clock
keywords.description: It is currently <color=#FED5AC>hour {0}</color> on <color=#FED5AC>day {1}</color>
keywords.descriptionZh: 现在是<color=#FED5AC>第{1}天</color>的<color=#FED5AC>第{0}小时</color>

keywords.name: ClockTournament
keywords.description: You are playing Tournament mode. It is currently <color=#FED5AC>hour {0}</color> on <color=#FED5AC>day {1}</color>. When the timer hits 0, end-of-day combat begins automatically.
keywords.descriptionZh: 您正在游玩锦标赛模式。当前为<color=#FED5AC>第{1}天</color>的<color=#FED5AC>第{0}小时</color>。当倒计时归零时，每日结束战斗将自动开始。

keywords.name: HeroSkins
keywords.description: Hero Skins allow you to change the look of your character. Show off your style to your opponents!
keywords.descriptionZh: 英雄皮肤可以让你改变角色的外观。向对手展示你的风格吧！
